title: INTRODUCTION TO STATISTICAL METHODS
description: Randomization tests and other nonparametric tests for one- and two-sample inference, simple and multiple linear regression, correlation, one- and two-way analysis of variance, logistic regression.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: ST 351 or 351H.
A minimum grade of D- is required in ST 351 and ST 351H.
meeting_html: T 5pm-6:20pm in BEXL 324 - Bexell Hall 324 (PC) (9/23 to 12/4)
